findings.title: Deployed stylesheet imports tokens from an unavailable relative path
findings.detail: The root stylesheet is exposed as /media.auth.css by the Nginx exact route, so @import url("./src/media/mediaDesignTokens.css") resolves relative to that URL (under /openclaw/media/ in the browser) rather than the contract and Nginx asset /mediaDesignTokens.css. The auth page therefore cannot load the required token stylesheet in the deployed/static-root environment, leaving --mg-* and --auth-* variables unresolved and breaking the auth presentation.
